hypothesis: For the 6-layer, d_model=128 model at m2 fixed and e in [0, 0.85], linear decodability of accel_step separates from prediction quality during training. Within each seed, accel_step R2 at the best layer levels off near 0.70 by step 2000, while val_mse_ratio keeps falling by at least 2x between step 2000 and step 4000. That would point to a linear-readout limit rather than undertraining (f-20261012-020024-760f, q-20261012-020024-7920).
expected_if_true: In both seeds, accel_step best-layer R2 changes by <= 0.03 between step 2000 and step 4000 and stays below 0.8 at every checkpoint, while val_mse_ratio at step 4000 is at most half its step-2000 value. accel_step still beats its best-of-5 control by >= required_margin at the end, with margin about 0.4 or more.
expected_if_false: In at least one seed, accel_step R2 rises by >= 0.05 between steps 2000 and 4000 (still climbing, so undertraining), or reaches >= 0.8 at any checkpoint. Alternatively, val_mse_ratio stops improving (step-4000 value > 0.5x the step-2000 value) at the same time R2 levels off, meaning the two plateau together rather than separating.
